name: National Securities Depository Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2012, National Securities Depository Ltd provides electronic infrastructure for dematerialization of securities and facilitates electronic settlement of trades in Indian Securities Market[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
NSDL is a SEBI-registered Market Infrastructure Institution (MII) offering a range of products and services to India’s financial and securities markets. It pioneered the dematerialization of securities in India. 
As of March 31st 2025, NSDL ranks as the 
largest depository in India based on number 
of issuers, number of active instruments, 
market share in demat value of settlement volume, and value of assets held under custody. NSDL’s nationwide infrastructure comprises 65,391 depository participants’ service centres, significantly exceeding CDSL’s 18,918 centres.

cons: Stock is trading at 10.3 times its book value
